title: Arbitrage opportunities — after costs
description: Which venues, directions, payment methods and hours produce net-profitable offers, how long they stay up, and how much theoretical profit they represent.

options.content: **Definitions.** *Closed offer* = left the order book in the selected range (`offers.last_seen`). The closed-offer analyzer stores lifetime averages on each offer: *gross premium* vs. reference price, *trade cost* (CEX taker + withdrawal, routing, hedge open/close/funding, DEX fee) and *net premium* = gross − cost. *Theoretical profit* is `avg_estimated_profit_fiat`: what taking the offer at its average size would have earned — an upper bound, since the bot must also win the race to take it. Data source: read-only `postgres-dexarb`.

panels.title: Best live offers by current net premium
panels.description: Live offers ranked by their latest lifecycle row. Positive net % = profitable after all modelled costs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT o.exchange::text AS exchange, o.direction::text AS direction, ROUND(lc.net_premium_pct::numeric, 2) AS "net %", ROUND(lc.premium_pct::numeric, 2) AS "gross %", ROUND(lc.trade_cost_pct::numeric, 2) AS "cost %", o.price AS price, o.btc_min AS "btc min", o.btc_max AS "btc max", array_to_string(o.payment_methods, ', ') AS "payment methods", o.best_route_cex::text AS "best route", ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - o.first_seen) / 60) AS "age min" FROM offers o CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ol.net_premium_pct, ol.premium_pct, ol.trade_cost_pct FROM order_lifecycle ol WHERE ol.offer_db_id = o.id ORDER BY ol.snapshot_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) lc WHERE o.is_live ORDER BY lc.net_premium_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 25
SELECT COUNT(*) AS offers FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen)

panels.title: Net-profitable share
panels.description: Of the closed offers the analyzer priced, the share with positive lifetime-average net premium.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG((avg_net_premium_pct > 0)::int) AS share FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS offers FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct > 0

panels.title: Theoretical profit (EUR)
panels.description: Upper bound: sum of avg_estimated_profit_fiat over net-profitable closed offers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(avg_estimated_profit_fiat), 0) AS eur FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct > 0 AND fiat_currency = 'EUR'

panels.title: Median life of a profitable offer
panels.description: How long a profitable offer typically stays in the book — the execution window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration) AS seconds FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct > 0 AND duration IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Profitable offers gone < 5 min
panels.description: Share of profitable offers that disappeared within ~1.5 snapshot cycles — realistically uncatchable at today's ~3 min snapshot cadence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG((duration < 300)::int) AS share FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct > 0 AND duration IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Net-profitable offers closed per day, by exchange

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(last_seen, '1d'), exchange::text AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Theoretical profit per day, by exchange (EUR)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(last_seen, '1d'), exchange::text AS metric, SUM(avg_estimated_profit_fiat) AS value FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct > 0 AND fiat_currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Where the premium goes — gross vs. cost vs. net (avg %, by market)
panels.description: Average over every priced closed offer, not just profitable ones. A market is structurally attractive when its gross premium clears its trade cost.

targets.rawSql: SELECT exchange::text || ' ' || direction::text AS market, ROUND(AVG(avg_premium_pct)::numeric, 2) AS "gross premium %", ROUND(AVG(avg_trade_cost_pct)::numeric, 2) AS "trade cost %", ROUND(AVG(avg_net_premium_pct)::numeric, 2) AS "net premium %" FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Execution window of profitable offers, by market
panels.description: How long net-profitable offers lived. Markets with a short p50 need faster snapshots or event-driven taking to be capturable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT exchange::text AS exchange, direction::text AS direction, COUNT(*) AS offers, ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "p50 min", ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "p90 min", ROUND(100.0 * AVG((duration < 300)::int)) AS "% gone < 5 min", ROUND(AVG(avg_net_premium_pct)::numeric, 2) AS "avg net %", ROUND(SUM(avg_estimated_profit_fiat)::numeric) AS "theoretical EUR" FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct > 0 AND duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY offers DESC

panels.title: Net-profitable offers by hour of first appearance (UTC)
panels.description: When opportunities appear — useful for operator availability and for scheduling faster snapshot cadences.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LPAD(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM first_seen AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int::text, 2, '0') AS hour, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'bid') AS bid, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'ask') AS ask FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Net-premium distribution of closed offers
panels.description: Lifetime-average net premium rounded to whole percent, clamped to ±10%. Mass just below 0% means small fee savings would unlock many offers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(bucket, 'S00') || '%' AS "net premium", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'bid') AS bid, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'ask') AS ask FROM ( SELECT direction, GREATEST(LEAST(ROUND(avg_net_premium_pct)::int, 10), -10) AS bucket FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct IS NOT NULL ) b GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Payment methods of net-profitable offers
panels.description: Which fiat rails the profitable offers accept — the rails worth having funded accounts on. An offer listing several methods counts once per method.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pm AS "payment method", COUNT(*) AS offers, ROUND(AVG(o.avg_net_premium_pct)::numeric, 2) AS "avg net %", ROUND(SUM(o.avg_estimated_profit_fiat)::numeric) AS "theoretical EUR" FROM offers o CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(o.payment_methods) AS pm WHERE NOT o.is_live AND $__timeFilter(o.last_seen) AND o.avg_net_premium_pct > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY offers DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Best CEX route for net-profitable offers
panels.description: Which CEX the router picked as cheapest hedge/settlement route. Tells you which venue's fees and account health matter most.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(best_route_cex::text, 'none') AS "best route", COUNT(*) AS offers, ROUND(AVG(avg_net_premium_pct)::numeric, 2) AS "avg net %", ROUND(SUM(avg_estimated_profit_fiat)::numeric) AS "theoretical EUR" FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND avg_net_premium_pct > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY offers DESC

panels.title: Closed-offer analysis outcomes per day
panels.description: analyzed = priced by the analyzer; non_premium = never above reference price; ignored_no_lifecycle = closed before any lifecycle row was written (too short-lived to observe).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(last_seen, '1d'), COALESCE(historical_analysis_status, 'not analyzed') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM offers WHERE NOT is_live AND $__timeFilter(last_seen) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
